sql:
with b as (select sk.exercise_id, t.level, sk.full_sentence sk, en.full_sentence en,
 row_number() over (partition by t.level order by md5(sk.exercise_id::text||'phase1w-B')) rn
 from exercise_localizations sk join exercise_localizations en on en.exercise_id=sk.exercise_id and en.language_code='en'
 join exercises e on e.id=sk.exercise_id join exercise_types t on t.id=e.exercise_type_id
 where sk.language_code='sk' and t.level in ('A1','A2','B1','B2') and coalesce(sk.full_sentence,'')<>''
 and sk.exercise_id not in (12449,17163,32590,29082,22140,24605,16816,34777,17130,19260,28577,34948,35822,15588,15672,24680,20857,15870,14871,13318,14283,35542,12124,18259,22229,34203,11634,12407,17993,32685,3524,9130,6572,7172,93,38955,4966,39944,37485,7896,38423,37778,10318,38000,37944,8038,2556,535,37937,44347,44249,41010,2180,42599,4271,39349,39022,3424,37457,10830))
 select exercise_id,level,sk,en from b where rn<=15 order by level,rn

rows.en: They have got nine screens, and the bright light destroys everything!
rows.sk: Oni majú deväť obrazoviek a to jasné svetlo ničí všetko!

rows.en: She has got a very excited dog on her bed.
rows.sk: Na posteli má veľmi natešeného psa.

rows.en: Ten papers fall on the wet street.
rows.sk: Desať papierov spadne na mokrú ulicu.

rows.en: She can free the zipper with one hard pull.
rows.sk: Ona vie zips uvoľniť jedným silným trhnutím.

rows.en: One jump per continent: Can she hit the target today?
rows.sk: Jeden skok na kontinent: Môže ona dnes trafiť cieľ?

rows.en: He walks up the stairs into the stadium.
rows.sk: On ide po schodoch hore na štadión.

rows.en: He kicks the ball into the goal every Sunday.
rows.sk: Každú nedeľu kope loptu do bránky.

rows.en: The coach puts the bandage around the ankle.
rows.sk: Trénerka dáva obväz okolo členka.

rows.en: The garden trampoline is very big and round.
rows.sk: Záhradná trampolína je veľmi veľká a okrúhla.

rows.en: This ring on her hand is her wedding ring.
rows.sk: Tento prsteň na jej ruke je svadobný.

rows.en: Man, he's gonna close three locks before dinner.
rows.sk: Kámo, on zavrie tri zámky pred večerou.

rows.en: In the garage there is one light and six concrete pillars.
rows.sk: V garáži je jedno svetlo a šesť betónových stĺpov

rows.en: The red ketchup falls onto the plate of fries.
rows.sk: Červený kečup padá na tanier s hranolkami.

rows.en: He waits ten minutes, and his stomach is empty for ten minutes.
rows.sk: On čaká desať minút a jeho žalúdok je prázdny desať minút.

rows.en: This sea is turquoise, clear and very salty.
rows.sk: Toto more je tyrkysové, čisté a veľmi slané.

rows.en: He does not need many towels for one dog.
rows.sk: Na jedného psa nepotrebuje veľa uterákov.

rows.en: There are two bowls on the kitchen table.
rows.sk: Na kuchynskom stole sú dve misky.

rows.en: The band usually plays outside, but today it is marching in a column.
rows.sk: Kapela zvyčajne hrá vonku, ale dnes pochoduje v kolóne.

rows.en: They eat fish often, but yesterday they had pizza.
rows.sk: Ryby jedia často, ale včera mali pizzu.

rows.en: She opens the fridge every day, but now she is finding a gift.
rows.sk: Chladničku otvára každý deň, ale teraz v nej nachádza darček.

rows.en: How many cats are on the tower?
rows.sk: Koľko mačiek je na veži?

rows.en: Look! She is talking on the phone right now.
rows.sk: Pozri! Práve teraz hovorí do telefónu.

rows.en: She usually washes hair quietly, but now she is laughing.
rows.sk: Zvyčajne umýva vlasy potichu, ale teraz sa smeje

rows.en: Girl, he told me he is going to fly a kite on every rooftop in the city.
rows.sk: Počuj, povedal mi, že on sa chystá púšťať šarkana na každej streche v meste.

rows.en: Last night she felt sleepy on the same train.
rows.sk: Včera v noci bola v tom istom vlaku rovnako ospalá

rows.en: He ran quietly through the city. Nobody noticed, obviously.
rows.sk: Bežal potichu cez mesto. Nikto si to, jasné, nevšimol.

rows.en: The basket will cost 30 euros, according to the budget.
rows.sk: Kôš bude stáť 30 eur, podľa rozpočtu.

rows.en: She went out of the blue door and waved goodbye.
rows.sk: Vyšla z modrých dverí a zamávala na rozlúčku.

rows.en: Wait five minutes and the floor will be dry.
rows.sk: Počkaj päť minút a podlaha bude suchá.

rows.en: The light is red. You should wait on the pavement.
rows.sk: Svieti červená. Mal by si počkať na chodníku.

rows.en: If you stand under a running shower, you get soaked because the water is wet.
rows.sk: Keď stojíš pod pustenou sprchou, premokneš, lebo voda je mokrá.

rows.en: His car used to look completely standard until he changed the rims and the exhaust.
rows.sk: Jeho auto kedysi vyzeralo úplne sériovo, kým nevymenil disky a výfuk.

rows.en: He's defrosted a fish like this before, hasn't he?
rows.sk: Už raz takto rozmrazoval rybu, však?

rows.en: Too many berries have completely destroyed the batter, haven't they?
rows.sk: Priveľa bobúľ úplne zničilo cesto, však?

rows.en: Her arms are aching because she has been squeezing that bar of soap since the church bell rang.
rows.sk: Bolia ju ruky, lebo tú kocku mydla stláča odkedy zazvonil kostolný zvon.

rows.en: This blush is made in a tiny factory in Italy, which is why it costs so much.
rows.sk: Táto lícenka sa vyrába v malinkej továrni v Taliansku, preto stojí toľko.

rows.en: The desk lamp was left on for the whole night by him.
rows.sk: Stolná lampa bola nechaná zapnutá celú noc.

rows.en: If you drop spice into hot oil, it opens into a red star.
rows.sk: Keď hodíš korenie do horúceho oleja, rozkvitne do červenej hviezdy.

rows.en: She knows every worker's name — she must have run this team for years.
rows.sk: Pozná meno každého pracovníka — ten tím musí viesť už roky.

rows.en: She supported her the whole time, didn't she?
rows.sk: Podporila ju celý čas, však?

rows.en: I promise I will never drop another block. Those bubbles were a total disaster!
rows.sk: Sľubujem, že už nikdy nehodím ďalší blok. Tie bubliny boli totálna katastrofa!

rows.en: Girl, the woman who lounged in the hammock at sunset quit her job, apparently.
rows.sk: Zlato, žena, ktorá sa pri západe slnka vyvaľovala v hojdacej sieti, vraj dala výpoveď.

rows.en: He has covered both hands in coal dust, hasn't he?
rows.sk: Obe ruky si zamazal uhoľným prachom, však nie?

rows.en: The first drumstick was pulled off the bird by the man in the apron.
rows.sk: Prvé stehno bolo odtrhnuté z kurčaťa mužom v zástere.

rows.en: The banknotes were counted by a machine at the counter before she walked into the lobby.
rows.sk: Bankovky boli spočítané strojom pri priehradke predtým, než vošla do vstupnej haly.

rows.en: Her friend wishes she had brought a book with her to that fitting room.
rows.sk: Kamarátka ľutuje, že si do tej kabínky nezobrala knihu.

rows.en: They had the banner printed before the march started.
rows.sk: Pred začiatkom sprievodu si dali vytlačiť veľký transparent.

rows.en: We had been riding in the dark for what felt like forever before the exit appeared!
rows.sk: My sme jazdili v tme celú večnosť, kým sa objavil východ!

rows.en: I wish I could make cocktails that look like a sunset in a glass.
rows.sk: Kiežby som vedela robiť koktaily, ktoré vyzerajú ako západ slnka v pohári.

rows.en: By this time next year that chubby cat will have grown into an even bigger orange cushion.
rows.sk: O rok o takomto čase vyrastie z toho bacuľatého kocúra ešte väčší ryšavý vankúš.

rows.en: By the end of the month they will have turned every old plate in the house into a mosaic.
rows.sk: Do konca mesiaca premenia každý starý tanier v dome na mozaiku.

rows.en: By sunset, you will have been hiking this trail for ten hours, treatment and all, honestly iconic.
rows.sk: Do západu slnka budeš ísť po tejto trase desať hodín, aj s ošetrením, úprimne ikonické.

rows.en: Lost in awe, he nearly bumped into a pillar; he should have looked where he was going.
rows.sk: Stratený v úžase takmer narazil do stĺpa; mal sa pozerať, kam ide.

rows.en: The hammock is said to be the most photographed spot in the whole hotel.
rows.sk: O tej hojdacej sieti sa hovorí, že je najfotografovanejšie miesto v celom hoteli.

rows.en: She told her coach she would take the top step this time.
rows.sk: Trénerke povedala, že tentoraz obsadí najvyšší stupienok.

rows.en: She knew the birch bark would come away in one clean curl before she even touched it.
rows.sk: Vedela, že brezová kôra sa odlúpi v jednom čistom zvitku, ešte než sa jej vôbec dotkla.

rows.en: Half of them come here straight from bed, still half asleep.
rows.sk: Polovica z nich sem chodí rovno z postele, ešte v polospánku.

rows.en: Nobody has crossed this corridor without a disaster since the bike arrived!
rows.sk: Odkedy prišiel bicykel, nikto neprešiel touto chodbou bez katastrofy!

rows.en: She dipped the paddle, pulled hard and glided past the bamboo.
rows.sk: Ponorila pádlo, silno zabrala a prekĺzla popri bambuse.

rows.en: The evening, which nobody mentions any more, ended with a warm smile.
rows.sk: Ten večer, ktorý už nikto nespomína, sa skončil vrelým úsmevom.
